newsitem.title: USA: Newmont sees Santa Fe merger synergies.
newsitem.headline: Newmont sees Santa Fe merger synergies.

text.p: Newmont Mining Corp said Wednesday it expected synergies from its merger with Santa Fe Pacific Gold Corp to total $40 million in the current year and $80 milion in 1998.

Newmont Gold Co, the operating company in which Newmont Mining holds a 94 percent interest, Wednesday posted a net loss of $69 million in the second quarter ended June 30, or $0.41 a share, after taking an $116 million after-tax charge, or $0.70 a share, to account for the merger.

Excluding the charges, which included writing off certain Santa Fe assets, Newmont Gold earned $47.5 million, or $0.29 a share, in the quarter, compared with a $25.7 million net, or $0.15 a share, last year.
A First Call poll of nine analysts had put the company's earnings at $0.27 a share.

The company attributed the quarterly operating income increase to sharply higher gold production (to 1.03 million ounces from 744,600) and lower costs ($193 an ounce from $221), which offset lower gold prices of $368 an ounce versus $396 a year ago.
Newmont Gold's Nevada operations produced 723,000 ounces of gold during the quarter at a total cash cost of $212 an ounce, compared with 543,100 ounces at $240 an ounce a year ago.
The company said the reduction in operating costs reflected savings from combining operations with Santa Fe.
Newmont said it expected the Rosebud underground mine in Nevada, a 50/50 joint venture with Hecla Mining Co, to produce 80,000 ounces of gold this year.
The mining company said it expected no impact on costs and production from a pit wall slide at the Nevada Betze Pit, operated by Barrick Gold Corp, this year.

The company said it is deferring some Betze Pit production scheduled for 1998 and 1999 to later years. Newmont added it expected to fully offset the wall slide's impact in 1998 and is reviewing alternative mine plans for 1999.
Newmont Gold's stock rose 1-1/8 to 41-3/4 Wednesday afternooon, while Newmont Mining was up 1-1/8 to 40-11/16.
